title: Capacity, load, fault and external monitoring evidence is still unexecuted

original_titles.title: D1 load test never executed; every results cell UNRUN
Capacity work missing: no 200-user synthetic seed, no EXPLAIN plans, load test UNRUN
Integration evidence incomplete: no contract suite, no Playwright e2e, no fault tests, load UNRUN
Load target qualification pending at every N; tool cannot run the N=100/200 points
Load-test tool measures API only; no server-side vs end-to-end latency split
No external monitoring, status page, alerting or external pen test
Observability signals below the required minimum
NFR instrumentation gaps: no OpenAPI contract tests, no axe a11y CI, thin metrics story

problem: LOAD_TEST_REPORT.md still has UNRUN in every results cell. The repo has scripts but no measured p50/p95/p99 results for API reads, submission burst, worker latency or four-level polling. There is no external monitoring/status page or demonstrated alert path.
impact: The seeded 50-participant cap and performance targets are assumptions, not verified capacity. Failures during event start or submission burst could cause missed receipts, delayed evaluation or unusable UI.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Fix and document the load test harness so it exercises the current four-level endpoints, real database locks, uploads, team score, leaderboard release and concurrent idempotent submissions.

Run approved participant/teams profiles at 50, 100 and 200 synthetic users (or approved targets), with synchronized T0 and submission bursts. Record machine/container profile, data volume, commit and exact commands.
Capture p50/p95/p99, 4xx/5xx, DB lock wait, pool saturation, queue lag, worker retry/dead-letter count and outbox delivery latency. Keep raw outputs attached.
Add fault tests for DB restart, worker restart, lease expiry, network loss and refresh token recovery.
Deploy external uptime/metrics/log alerts and an incident/status page; rehearse alert acknowledgement and escalation.

acceptance_criteria: Report contains measured values, not UNRUN placeholders.
At approved cap, p95 targets and zero-5xx criteria pass.
Restart/fault drills recover with no duplicate scores or lost submissions.
External alert is triggered and acknowledged during a drill.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: Current GitHub CI passed 81 pytest tests, 74.03% coverage and 46/46 live E2E checks, but that is not a load test or restore drill.
